changes.title: Tabbed settings
changes.description: Settings now uses dedicated tabs for Network, Database & Loot, Character, Garmoth, Overlay, Keybinds, and Ignore List. The active tab is underlined, and Save Changes stays visible at the bottom.

changes.title: Storage filtering
changes.description: Storage and Transaction Maid withdrawals detected by the tested transfer packet are no longer counted as loot.

changes.title: Overlay improvements
changes.description: Overlay position saving is more reliable, a reset button was added, and the loot list can now be sorted by quantity, last loot time, total value, or unit price.

changes.title: System Tray
changes.description: Closing the main window now lets you exit, cancel, or keep the tracker running in the system tray while the overlay remains available.

changes.title: Global keybinds
changes.description: Optional global shortcuts can toggle Start / Stop Tracking and Overlay ON / OFF, even while BDO is focused or the tracker is in the tray.

changes.title: Garmoth quick upload
changes.description: A Garmoth upload panel is back under STOP on the main screen. It uploads the most recent completed session without opening Session History.

changes.title: Live update notification
changes.description: The tracker now checks for updates while it is running and shows a small update button in the bottom status bar. Clicking it downloads, installs, and restarts the app.

changes.title: Reliable What's New
changes.description: The updater now records the pending target version before restart, so the changelog is shown reliably once after an update finishes.

changes.title: Optional Garmoth loot filter
changes.description: Settings → Garmoth now includes a checkbox to track only item IDs found in the cached Garmoth grind-drop list. Turn it off to track every detected loot item.

changes.title: Shared loot sorting
changes.description: The Overlay loot sort setting now controls both the main-screen Loot List and the in-game overlay.

changes.title: Npcap diagnostics
changes.description: Settings → Network now shows whether Npcap is installed and whether capture adapters are visible, with a Recheck button.

changes.title: BDO patch loot parser hotfix
changes.description: Loot detection was updated for the 2026-09-03 BDO packet format. The parser now uses the new framed loot packet signature and data offsets observed in the post-maintenance capture.

changes.title: Remote parser profiles
changes.description: Packet signatures, framing, offsets, server port, and safety limits now come from a JSON parser profile that can be updated independently from the application.

changes.title: Parser Auto Repair
changes.description: Starting a session can fetch a newer SHA-256 verified parser profile. A last-known-good copy is kept for rollback if a repair cannot be validated.

changes.title: Parser health warning
changes.description: During an active session, substantial BDO traffic with no valid loot for several minutes can trigger a recovery popup with Auto Repair and Diagnostics options.

changes.title: Network parser diagnostics
changes.description: Settings → Network now shows the local parser profile and provides Diagnostics, Check for parser update, and Auto Repair. These remote checks do not run just because the app was opened.

changes.title: Packet sample fallback
changes.description: The parser manifest can advertise a newer pcapng sample for larger protocol changes. Auto Repair can cache the sample for diagnostics while JSON profiles remain non-executable data.

changes.title: Faster live update detection
changes.description: While the tracker is running, it now checks for a newer GitHub release every two minutes. The bottom-right update button can appear without restarting the application and continues to work while the app is in the tray.

changes.title: Reliable What's New after updates
changes.description: Before Velopack restarts, the target version is stored in both settings and a durable pending-update marker. What's New is shown only after the main window has rendered, and the marker is cleared only after the dialog was successfully displayed.

changes.title: Changelog recovery fallback
changes.description: If a build is missing its detailed changelog entry, the tracker still confirms that the new version was installed instead of silently showing nothing. Failed changelog display attempts remain pending and retry on the next start.

changes.title: Startup update prompt
changes.description: If an update is already available when the tracker starts, a BDO Loot Tracker styled update window now offers Later or Update now. Updates discovered while the app is already running remain a small bottom-right Click here notification.

changes.title: Consistent in-app dialogs
changes.description: Standard Windows message boxes used by the tracker have been replaced with a shared dark BDO Loot Tracker dialog design for information, warnings, errors, confirmations, and Yes/No/Cancel prompts.

changes.title: Garmoth upload preview
changes.description: Garmoth uploads now open a review window first. Every loot quantity can be corrected for the upload without changing the original packet-tracked session, and previously uploaded sessions are clearly marked to help avoid duplicates.

changes.title: Drop Rate field
changes.description: The Garmoth upload preview includes an optional Drop Rate value. The tracker tries the external API field once and, if Garmoth rejects that validation field, safely retries the session without it while keeping the value locally.

changes.title: Session History redesign
changes.description: Session History is now organized by grind spot. All Spots is selected by default, spot filters update Total Silver, Silver/hr, Trash/hr and Total Time, and sessions are shown as compact expandable cards with main-loot previews.

changes.title: Session screenshot generator
changes.description: Expanded session cards can generate a shareable PNG summary containing the grind spot, class/spec, duration, totals, drop rate and the complete visible loot list.

changes.title: Cleaner Garmoth upload preview
changes.description: The Garmoth review window is narrower and more compact, with corrected dark DataGrid row/cell styling so item names, quantities, prices and totals remain readable.

changes.title: Drop Rate handled locally
changes.description: The external Garmoth session endpoint currently ignores the attempted Drop Rate field even when the request succeeds. The tracker now treats Drop Rate as local session metadata and no longer claims it was transferred to Garmoth.

changes.title: Screenshot preview
changes.description: Generate Screenshot now opens an in-app preview first with Copy, Save As and Close actions instead of immediately asking for a file path.

changes.title: Compact share card
changes.description: Session screenshots are narrower and denser, and the BDO Loot Tracker application icon is now shown next to the tracker name at the top of the generated image.

changes.title: Even more compact session screenshot
changes.description: The generated session card now uses a tighter two-row summary layout: Total Silver and Silver/hr on the first row, then Trash/hr and Drop Rate on the second row.

changes.title: Icon-first acquired loot section
changes.description: Session screenshots now show acquired loot as compact icon tiles with quantity badges instead of a full text loot list, keeping the image narrower and easier to share.

changes.title: Session actions available before expansion
changes.description: Upload to Garmoth, Generate Screenshot and Delete Session are now available directly on each Session History card before expanding it, right next to the expand button.

changes.title: New update experience
changes.description: If an update is already available when BDO Loot Tracker starts, a styled in-app prompt now offers Later or Update now. Updates discovered while the program is already running remain a compact bottom-right Update available / Click here notification.

changes.title: Unified BDO Loot Tracker dialogs
changes.description: The remaining standard Windows message boxes were replaced by shared dark in-app dialogs so information, warnings, errors and confirmations match the rest of the application.

changes.title: Garmoth upload review and editing
changes.description: Upload to Garmoth now opens a compact review window first. Loot quantities can be corrected for the outgoing upload without changing the original packet-tracked loot, while uploaded sessions are clearly marked with their last upload time and upload count.

changes.title: Session Drop Rate metadata
changes.description: Drop Rate is now stored as local session metadata and can be edited directly from the expanded Session History card. The same saved value is reused by the Garmoth upload preview and the generated session screenshot. Unknown Drop Rate is shown as — instead of 0%.

changes.title: Session History redesigned around grind spots
changes.description: Session History now starts on All Spots and includes a left-side list of grind spots you actually visited. Selecting a spot filters the session cards and recalculates Total Silver, Silver/hr, Trash/hr and Total Time for that selection.

changes.title: Compact expandable session cards
changes.description: Sessions are presented as compact cards with class/spec, silver/hr, trash/hr and main-loot icon previews. Cards can still be expanded for full loot details, while Upload to Garmoth, Generate Screenshot and Delete Session are available directly before expansion.

changes.title: Shareable session screenshot generator
changes.description: Generate Screenshot opens an in-app preview with Copy, Save As and Close. The share card uses the app icon, grind spot and session details, a compact two-row stat layout and icon-only acquired loot with quantity badges.

changes.title: Sharper compact screenshots
changes.description: Session screenshots are now rendered at 2x resolution for cleaner text and icons while keeping the same compact card proportions. The app icon is larger and loot quantity badges were widened so values such as x12,641 fit cleanly.

changes.title: Garmoth preview visual refinements
changes.description: The Garmoth upload window was tightened and its loot editor now uses consistent dark rows and cells so quantities, prices and totals remain easy to read.

changes.title: New update experience
changes.description: If an update is already available when BDO Loot Tracker starts, a styled in-app prompt offers Later or Update now. Updates discovered while the program is already running remain a compact bottom-right Update available / Click here notification, with background checks continuing while the app is open.

changes.title: Reliable post-update changelog
changes.description: After an update and restart, the What's New window is shown reliably after the main window has rendered. Pending update markers remain until the changelog was actually displayed, and a fallback message is shown if detailed changelog data is unavailable.

changes.title: Unified BDO Loot Tracker dialogs
changes.description: Standard Windows message boxes used by the tracker were replaced with shared dark in-app dialogs so information, warnings, errors and confirmations match the rest of the application.

changes.title: Garmoth upload review and editing
changes.description: Upload to Garmoth now opens a compact review window first. Loot quantities can be corrected for the outgoing upload without changing the original packet-tracked loot, while previously uploaded sessions are clearly marked with their last upload time and upload count.

changes.title: Session Drop Rate metadata
changes.description: Drop Rate is stored as local session metadata and can be edited directly from the expanded Session History card. The same saved value is reused by the Garmoth upload preview and generated session screenshots. Unknown Drop Rate is shown as — instead of 0%.

changes.title: Session History redesigned around grind spots
changes.description: Session History starts on All Spots and includes a left-side list of grind spots you actually visited. Selecting a spot filters the session cards and recalculates Total Silver, Silver/hr, Trash/hr and Total Time for that selection.

changes.title: Compact expandable session cards
changes.description: Sessions are shown as compact cards with class/spec, silver/hr, trash/hr and main-loot icon previews. Cards can still be expanded for full loot details, while Upload to Garmoth, Generate Screenshot and Delete Session are available directly before expansion.

changes.title: Shareable session screenshot workflow
changes.description: Generate Screenshot opens an in-app preview with Copy, Save As and Close. The share card includes the tracker branding, grind spot and session details, a compact two-row stat layout and icon-only acquired loot with quantity badges.

changes.title: Sharper and cleaner session cards
changes.description: Session screenshots render at 2x resolution for cleaner text and item icons. The card now has rounded outer corners, uses the same transparent header logo as the main window, and keeps a compact share-friendly width.

changes.title: Refined acquired-loot badges
changes.description: Loot quantity labels are now smaller, more transparent and fully contained inside each item tile instead of extending beyond the item border. Values such as x12,641 remain readable while larger quantities can use compact K / M / B formatting.

changes.title: Garmoth preview visual refinements
changes.description: The Garmoth upload window is tighter and its loot editor uses consistent dark rows and cells so quantities, prices and totals remain easy to read.

changes.title: Windows-only platform cleanup
changes.description: The Windows-only main window is explicitly marked for the Windows platform so tray-icon and other intentional Windows API usage no longer produces unnecessary cross-platform analyzer warnings.
